name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump gets a big win at the Supreme Court and the NBA hands out a massive punishment: The news quiz
changes.summary: A former congressman got hit with a ban, an artist had his upcoming Met Gala exhibition pulled, and a record carrier deployment finally came to an end.

changes.title: Week in Politics: Trump's face on the coin; reshaping the capital; the midterms
changes.summary: President Trump is the first living president to have his face on a coin. He's also reshaping Washington in his image, and working to influence midterm elections.

changes.title: How the U.S. focus on Iran is fueling a more aggressive Putin
changes.summary: Trump's top envoys head to Moscow and Kyiv as Putin steps up round the clock bombing of Ukraine. With the U.S. distracted by Iran, is Putin becoming increasingly emboldened?

changes.title: Trump delivers $10 million to Ken Paxton in first major contribution of midterms
changes.summary: President Trump's MAGA Inc. super PAC had previously only given one donation this midterm cycle: about $800,000 to Darline Graham.

changes.title: Renewed calls for Trump-backed Kennedy Center repairs after part of foyer ceiling falls
changes.summary: No one was injured when a piece of the ceiling inside the Kennedy Center's grand foyer partially collapsed Friday evening, said Roma Daravi, the center's vice president for public relations.

changes.title: Guyana latest "third country" to accept migrants deported from U.S.
changes.summary: Guyana is one of more than 30 nations that have now signed deals with the Trump administration as part of President Trump's crackdown on illegal immigration.

changes.title: US military hits 3 Iranian oil tankers after saying Navy warships were targeted
changes.summary: The strikes come a day after President Trump appeared to downplay the war with Iran as "small potatoes" during an exchange with reporters in the Oval Office. (Image credit: Vahid Salemi).

changes.title: U.S. strikes 3 Iranian oil tankers after saying warships were targeted with ballistic missiles
changes.summary: The strikes — a day after U.S. President Donald Trump sought to minimize the conflict as "small potatoes" — keep up a new tilt back toward fighting after six months of on-again, off-again war.

changes.title: Trump's first major midterm money move: A $10 million Texas Senate ad blitz
changes.summary: This is the first significant spending in a premier general election contest by MAGA, Inc., and reflects how a once-safe Republican seat in Texas may be viable for Democrats with the candidacy of James Talarico.

changes.title: Kennedy Center renews call for Trump-backed shutdown after part of a ceiling collapses
changes.summary: No one was injured when a piece of the ceiling inside the Kennedy Center's grand foyer collapsed Friday evening, said Roma Daravi, the center's vice president for public relations.
